identificationModule.briefTitle: A Phase II Clinical Study of Surufatinib Combined With Sintilimab in the Treatment of Advanced Gastric Cancer
identificationModule.officialTitle: An Open-label, Single Center, Phase II Study of Surufatinib Combined With Sintilimab in Patients With Advanced Adenocarcinoma of the Gastric or Gastrooesophageal Junction Adneocarcinoma Cancer

descriptionModule.briefSummary: The efficacy and safety of the use of Surufatinib in combination with Sintilimab.

interventions.name: Surufatinib+Sintilimab
interventions.description: Surufatinib at a dose of 250mg Qd, with humanized anti-PD-1 monoclonal antibody Sintilimab injected intravenously 200mg per 3 weeks until disease progresses or unacceptable tolerability occurs.

primaryOutcomes.description: Objective response rate (ORR) according to Response Evaluation Criteria in Solid Tumours (RECIST) version. 1.1, and immune-related (ir) RECIST
